title: Workspace
description: The set of repos a Manager may deploy agents into for one goal. Read by the Manager before decomposition; the per-repo briefs are what stop agents burning budget rediscovering each repo.

id.description: Short handle. Every task and write path is qualified by it: 'api:src/auth.ts'.

path.description: Absolute local path to the working copy.

role.description: producer: defines the contract others build against. consumer: depends on it. both: mid-chain. independent: no cross-repo coupling in this goal.

depends_on.description: Repo ids whose contract change must land first.

brief.description: Path to the repo brief (templates/repo-brief.md). Required for any repo the team has not worked in before.

commands.description: How to build and test HERE. Agents must not have to discover these.

test_one.description: Narrow run, for use during work. The full suite runs once before handoff.

cold.description: True if no agent has worked here recently. Cold repos get a budget uplift for orientation; see resource-discipline.md.

write_allowed.description: False makes the repo read-only for this goal — agents may read it for context but never modify it.

contracts.description: The interfaces that bind repos together. Owned by the Architect, recorded as ADRs.

surface.description: The actual API, schema, event, or wire format.

compatibility.description: How the change lands without an atomic cross-repo merge. expand-contract is the default: add the new surface, migrate consumers, remove the old one in a later task.

isolation.description: worktree-per-agent gives each agent its own checkout so parallel work in one repo cannot collide. Costs setup time and disk; use shared-checkout only when tasks are strictly serialised.
